###


Advisory: New fields in UPI AutoPay presentation callbacks (attempt_decentro_txn_id & split_settlement_rule_urn)


####


Deployment Date - 19th Nov 2026


We’re adding two new fields to UPI AutoPay presentation callbacks. They will make it easier to match each callback to the exact debit attempt it relates to, and to reconcile split settlements. This change is additive. No existing field is being removed, renamed, or changed in value.


1. ` attempt_decentro_txn_id`


1. A presentation can involve more than one debit attempt: either when merchant manually re-present a failed present, or when Decentro retries it automatically.
2. Today, every callback for a presentation carries the` decentro_txn_id` of the first attempt, so the merchant can’t tell which attempt a given callback belongs to.


Field What it identifies Changes across attempts?


` decentro_txn_id` (existing)
The presentation (first attempt) No, unchanged from today


` attempt_decentro_txn_id` (new) The second/ subsequent attempts the callback is for Yes


###


Scenarios to understand :


1. Single attempt: both fields carry the same value.


1. Manual re-presentation: say attempt 1 fails and the merchant re-presents, and attempt 2 succeeds. The success callback carries` decentro_txn_id` = first attempt’s transaction ID and` attempt_decentro_txn_id` = second attempt’s transaction ID.
2. Auto re-presentation: each callback carries` decentro_txn_id` = first attempt’s transaction ID and` attempt_decentro_txn_id` = the attempt’s transaction ID that callback belongs to.


1. ` split_settlement_rule_urn`


1. If a split settlement rule applies to the presentation, the callback will include` split_settlement_rule_urn` , set to the rule used to settle that presentation.
2. This holds even if a re-presentation request did not resend the rule. The field reflects the rule which was sent in the previous attempt.
3. If no` split_settlement_rule_urn` is sent in any of the attempts then this field is dropped from the callback.


###


Sample callback :


```text
{
"decentro_txn_id": "<first attempt ID>",
"attempt_decentro_txn_id": "<this attempt's ID>",
"split_settlement_rule_urn": "<rule URN, if applicable>",
"...": "all existing fields unchanged"
}
```

###


Action Required :


1. If your callback handler rejects unknown fields, update it to accept these fields before 19th Nov 2026. Otherwise callbacks may fail on your end.
2. To track re-presentations at the attempt level, map callbacks using` attempt_decentro_txn_id` . Continue using` decentro_txn_id` to identify the presentation


For any further queries, please reach out to us.
